Initial CDD for individuals

Before you provide a designated service to an individual customer you must complete initial customer due diligence appropriate to the customer's money laundering and terrorism financing risk.

KYC information to collect

For an individual customer, collect at least the customer's full name, date of birth and residential address, and understand the nature and purpose of the business relationship.

Verifying identity

Verify the customer's identity using reliable and independent documents or electronic data. If the customer cannot provide standard identity documents, you may use alternative evidence such as a letter from a government agency or a referee statement, as set out in your AML/CTF policies.

When simplified CDD may apply

If the customer's ML/TF risk is low and no enhanced customer due diligence trigger applies, you may apply simplified customer due diligence, for example by reducing the evidence you collect.
